Name: Tenant isolation
Description: A user, integration, or AI agent may access only records belonging to an authorized tenant.
Condition: actor tenant scope contains record tenant

Name: Permission deny precedence
Description: An explicit deny overrides any allow at the same or broader applicable scope.

Name: Least privilege default
Description: New users receive no business permissions until assigned an approved role.
Action: Permit sign-in only to onboarding or access-request surfaces
Exception: Tenant template may add approved baseline role

Name: One active policy version
Description: Only one policy version may be active for the same policy key, scope, and effective period.

Name: Approval independence
Description: A requester cannot approve their own request when dual control is required.

Name: Delegation boundary
Description: Delegated authority cannot exceed the delegator's permissions, amount, scope, or expiration.

Name: Suspension effect
Description: Suspending a user revokes active sessions and prevents new authentication.

Name: Legal hold precedence
Description: An active legal hold prevents purge regardless of ordinary retention expiration.

Name: Configuration precedence
Description: Effective configuration resolves from user, project, office, company, tenant, platform, using only override-enabled keys.

Name: Audit immutability
Description: Audit events cannot be edited or deleted through ordinary application workflows.

Name: Break-glass duration
Description: Emergency access expires at the earlier of policy maximum or approved expiration.

Name: AI proposal writeback
Description: AI output affecting governed records is stored as a proposal until required approval succeeds.
Inputs: agent action; target object; automation policy

Name: Locked baseline protection
Description: A locked record version cannot be modified in place.
Action: Create change request and successor version

Name: External sharing minimum
Description: External users receive only explicitly shared objects and approved portal actions.
Action: Evaluate explicit share and portal permission

Name: Entitlement enforcement
Description: A disabled or expired entitlement blocks new use but retains governed historical data.
